name: slides-notebook
description: Opens the markdown of a slides-rs deck as a notebook, runs its code cells as the deck does, and saves their outputs where the deck reads them. It runs slides-rs from the workspace's pixi environment.

commands.title: Collapse or Expand the Steps' Column

colors.description: The background of the line where a slide of a deck's markdown begins: its rule, or an import.
The background of a slide's title, a `#` heading, in a deck's markdown.
The background of a subtitle, a `##` heading, in a deck's markdown.
The background of a column's heading, a `###`, in a deck's markdown.
The line down a column of a deck's markdown, before its text.
The line down every other column of a deck's markdown, beside the one before, before its text.
The steps written before a line of a deck's markdown that steps.
The background of the column the steps are written in, before the lines of a deck's markdown.
The background of every other slide of a deck's markdown, so that two in a row tell apart.

slides.editor.show.markdownDescription: Which marks of the slides to show in a deck's markdown.

slideBreaks.description: Mark the line of each rule (---) or <import-slide> that breaks a slide from the one before.

slideLabels.description: Write after each break which slide follows it.

overviewRuler.description: Mark each break on the scrollbar too.

alternateSlides.description: Shade the slides in the colors of slides.editor.colors.slides, by turns, so that two in a row tell apart.

headings.description: Highlight a slide's title (#), its subtitles (##) and its columns' headings (###), each in a color and font of its own.

columns.description: Draw a line down each column, from its ### to the next, before its text, in the colors of slides.editor.colors.columns, by turns.

steps.description: Write before each line that steps, in a column of their own, the steps it shows in, as the deck numbers them: 3 from the third on, 2..4 up to the fourth, and a * if it takes no space while hidden. Hovering over the column collapses or expands it.

stepCounts.description: Write above each slide how many steps it has, which collapses or expands the steps' column, if steps are shown.

slides.editor.buttons.markdownDescription: Which buttons to show above each slide.

moveUp.description: Move the slide before the one above it.

moveDown.description: Move the slide after the one below it.

moveTo.description: Move the slide before another one.

newSlideAbove.description: Add a slide before this one.

newSlideBelow.description: Add a slide after this one.

slides.editor.previewFollowsCursor.markdownDescription: In the integrated browser, go to the slide and step the cursor is at as it moves, rather than only once a save is rendered. Takes effect as **Slides: Show Slides** opens the page.

slides.editor.colors.markdownDescription: The colors of the marks. A CSS color, as `#ff000040`, or a theme color's id, as `slides.title`, which `workbench.colorCustomizations` sets too. Empty, none. `slides` and `columns` are lists, taken by turns, as many as they have.

slideBreak.markdownDescription: The line of a break, and its mark on the scrollbar.

slideLabel.markdownDescription: What is written after a break.

slides.markdownDescription: The background of the slides, taken by turns: the first slide in the first, the second in the second, and so on, starting over after the last.

title.markdownDescription: The background of a slide's title (`#`).

subtitle.markdownDescription: The background of a slide's subtitles (`##`).

columnHeading.markdownDescription: The background of a column's heading (`###`).

columns.markdownDescription: The line down each column, taken by turns among the columns side by side.

stepColumn.markdownDescription: The background of the steps' column.

step.markdownDescription: The steps written in their column.

slides.editor.fonts.markdownDescription: The fonts of the marks. Words of a CSS font: a weight, as `bold` or `600`, and a style, as `italic`, as in `bold italic`. Left out, `normal`.

slideLabel.markdownDescription: What is written after a break.
The space before what is written after a break, in `em`.

stepPadding.markdownDescription: The space on each side of the steps in their column, in characters.

columnIndent.markdownDescription: How far a column, from its `###` to the next, is moved over, with its line, after the steps' column, in characters: a column within another's twice as far, and so on. `0` does not move it.

columnBarWidth.markdownDescription: The width of the line down each column, in pixels. `0` draws none.

beforeText.markdownDescription: The space between the steps' column, or the columns' line, and the text, in characters.

slides.editor.labels.markdownDescription: What is written after a break.

slide.markdownDescription: After a break, of the slide that follows it: `${number}` its number and `${title}` its heading, or else its first line.

end.markdownDescription: After a break that no slide follows.

titleLength.markdownDescription: How many characters of a slide's title to write, the last of them an ellipsis if it is longer.

slides.editor.stepMarks.markdownDescription: What is written in the steps' column.

separator.markdownDescription: Between the steps of a line that steps more than once.

range.markdownDescription: Between the first step of a range and the one it ends before.

noSpace.markdownDescription: After the steps of a line that takes no space while hidden.

collapsed.markdownDescription: In the collapsed steps' column, on a line that steps.

slides.pythonServer.markdownDescription: The Python language server for the code cells in the markdown text editor, which the language server starts in the environment they run in: a command, such as `basedpyright-langserver`, `ty`, `pyright-langserver` or `pyrefly`, or its path. Empty, the first of those installed in that environment, or on the `PATH`. `off`, none.

slides.path.markdownDescription: The `slides-rs` command, which serves the editor as `slides-rs lsp`, runs the code cells and renders the slides. Empty, `slides-rs` in the pixi environment of the workspace's first folder, as `pixi run --frozen slides-rs`. Takes effect once the window reloads.
